sales_baseline.sonnet: baseline refused after rows reached the gateway; final combined experiment was correct but had high startup time

baseline_comparison.release_probe_result: small live-gateway text and tool probes passed on all three models; this is not a p95 or universal latency claim

limits: No gateway source, shared gateway rule, policy, deployment, or app audience was changed.
The controlled gateway proves Sage and app response handling, not gateway-internal policy coverage.
Missing provider receipt, decision-stage, cache, fallback, and absent serving-model evidence stay unknown.
Direct deployed-app requests and internal gateway fallback remain outside full runtime restriction guarantees.
Existing projects and already deployed apps were not migrated.
The live model probe used small fixed prompts and does not prove semantic correctness for arbitrary data or p95 latency.
